description: This file contains C++ test code using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks, focused on contract testing for an RDK service. It defines classes, test cases, and utilities for activating/deactivating plugins, setting up device configurations, and verifying contract compliance through system calls and JSON result parsing.

classes.name: CTVerifier_Test
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for setup, teardown, and utility functions related to verifying contracts in the system.

classes.name: CTVerifier_CallMocks
classes.description: A subclass of CTVerifier_Test that configures mock behaviors for plugin interaction testing.

classes.name: CTVerifierMain
classes.description: A subclass of CTVerifier_CallMocks serving as the main test class that runs contract verification tests.

methods.name: createDeviceFiles
methods.description: Creates device properties and version files required by plugins, writing relevant info into /etc/device.properties and /version.txt.

methods.name: enableTTS
methods.description: Configures Text-to-Speech (TTS) plugin by invoking relevant service methods to enable TTS and set configurations.

methods.name: activateAllPlugins
methods.description: Activates all listed plugins by calling ActivateService on each plugin in vtrPlugins, and then enables TTS.

methods.name: deactivateAllPlugins
methods.description: Deactivates all plugins listed in vtrPlugins by calling DeactivateService.

methods.name: parseContractTestResults
methods.description: Parses the JSON results from contract tests, counts failures, logs the details, and writes summarized results to a file.
